# Warden

> Warden is the ground truth for AI code review. It runs deterministic tools (TSC, ESLint, npm audit with OSV, duplication, security lint), serves them to an agent runtime over MCP (`warden mcp`; OpenCode first), and publishes only findings that pass a deterministic post-pass the model cannot skip: citation verification, lane scope, secret screening, confidence rules, and a volume cap. Every path returns the same stable CommentSet. Direction: ADR-0053. `warden review` (the in-process loop) stays the default until the parity eval clears.

## Pages

- [Home](https://wrdn.beauty/): The split between Warden and the agent runtime, the review path, MCP setup, comment anatomy.
- [Docs · Overview](https://wrdn.beauty/docs/): What Warden does, why it hands the loop to an agent runtime, and the commands.
- [Docs · Install](https://wrdn.beauty/docs/install/): How to install and run the CLI locally.
- [Docs · Configuration](https://wrdn.beauty/docs/configuration/): Environment variables and review modes.
- [Docs · Reading comments](https://wrdn.beauty/docs/reading-comments/): How to read the tier/category/source shape of a comment.
- [Docs · Review pipeline](https://wrdn.beauty/docs/review/): Det-priors, lanes (up, down, surface, judge), the post-pass, and where the cutover stands.
- [Docs · MCP and OpenCode](https://wrdn.beauty/docs/mcp/): Connect an MCP client, the tool envelope rules, `warden opencode-review`, and `warden post-pass`.
- [Docs · CI usage](https://wrdn.beauty/docs/ci/): The deterministic gate and the opt-in lane review workflow.
- [Examples](https://wrdn.beauty/examples/): A rendered fixture from Warden reviewing its own codebase.
- [Design](https://wrdn.beauty/design/): Links into decisions.md, vision.md, and CONTEXT.md.
- [Notes](https://wrdn.beauty/notes/): Longer-form product and architecture writing.
- [Notes · The reviewer should bring receipts](https://wrdn.beauty/notes/reviewer-with-receipts/): The product thesis.
